definitions.explanation: An organized armed resistance against an established authority or government. Also used figuratively for strong defiance.

examples.japanese: {軍|ぐん}が{反乱|はんらん}を{鎮圧|ちんあつ}した。
{農民|のうみん}たちは{重|おも}い{税|ぜい}に{耐|た}えかねて{反乱|はんらん}を{起|お}こした。
examples.english: The farmers, unable to bear the heavy taxes, raised a revolt.

notes:
Distinguished from the homophone {氾濫|はんらん} (flood, overflow). {反乱|はんらん} specifically refers to armed resistance or revolt against authority.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反乱|はんらん}を{起|お}こす — to stage a rebellion
- {反乱|はんらん}を{鎮圧|ちんあつ}する — to suppress a rebellion
- {反乱|はんらん}{軍|ぐん} — rebel army
- {反乱|はんらん}{分子|ぶんし} — rebel element, insurgent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {暴動|ぼうどう} — riot (more spontaneous, less organized)
- {謀反|むほん} — treason, revolt (historical, against a lord)
- {革命|かくめい} — revolution (larger scale, aims to change the system)
